diff --git a/i18n/locale.py b/i18n/locale.py
--- a/i18n/locale.py
+++ b/i18n/locale.py
@@ -4,2 +4,3 @@ def select(requested):
+    if requested not in SUPPORTED_LOCALES:
+        return "en"
     return requested

## Summary
Fall back to English when a requested locale is unsupported.
## Changes
- Check requested locales against SUPPORTED_LOCALES.
- Return en for unsupported locale values.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Low — unsupported locale requests now resolve to a stable default.

## Summary
Use the system theme when a requested theme is not supported.
## Changes
- Validate theme names against THEMES.
- Fall back to system for unknown names.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Low — invalid preferences now use the operating-system default.

diff --git a/auth/redirect.py b/auth/redirect.py
--- a/auth/redirect.py
+++ b/auth/redirect.py
@@ -10,2 +10,4 @@ def destination(value):
+    if value not in ALLOWED_REDIRECTS:
+        return "/dashboard"
     return value

## Summary
Send unapproved post-login redirects to the dashboard.
## Changes
- Check redirect destinations against ALLOWED_REDIRECTS.
- Use /dashboard when a destination is not allowed.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Medium — external redirect behavior is now constrained by an allowlist.

## Summary
Use the raw parser when no named parser is registered.
## Changes
- Resolve known parser names from the parsers map.
- Fall back to the raw parser for unknown names.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Low — unknown modes now produce raw output instead of no parser.

diff --git a/plans/tier.py b/plans/tier.py
--- a/plans/tier.py
+++ b/plans/tier.py
@@ -3,2 +3,3 @@ def normalize(tier):
+    return tier if tier in ACTIVE_TIERS else "basic"

## Summary
Normalize inactive or unknown plan tiers to basic.
## Changes
- Preserve tiers listed in ACTIVE_TIERS.
- Return basic for every other tier.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Medium — unrecognized subscriptions now receive basic-tier behavior.

diff --git a/webhooks/dispatch.py b/webhooks/dispatch.py
--- a/webhooks/dispatch.py
+++ b/webhooks/dispatch.py
@@ -12,2 +12,4 @@ def dispatch(event):
+    handler = HANDLERS.get(event.type)
+    if handler is None: return Ignored()
+    return handler(event)

## Summary
Ignore webhook event types that have no registered handler.
## Changes
- Look up event handlers by event type.
- Return Ignored for unknown event types and dispatch known ones.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Low — unsupported webhook events are explicitly skipped.

diff --git a/mobile/tabs.kt b/mobile/tabs.kt
--- a/mobile/tabs.kt
+++ b/mobile/tabs.kt
@@ -8,2 +8,3 @@ fun open(tab: String) {
+    val target = if (allowedTabs.contains(tab)) tab else "overview"
+    navigator.open(target)
 }

## Summary
Open the overview tab when a requested mobile tab is unavailable.
## Changes
- Check requested tabs against allowedTabs.
- Navigate to known tabs or fall back to overview.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Low — invalid tab links now land on the overview screen.

diff --git a/export/format.py b/export/format.py
--- a/export/format.py
+++ b/export/format.py
@@ -2,2 +2,3 @@ def exporter(name):
+    return EXPORTERS.get(name, EXPORTERS["csv"])

## Summary
Default unknown export formats to CSV.
## Changes
- Resolve named exporters from EXPORTERS.
- Use the CSV exporter when the requested format is unknown.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Low — unsupported format names now generate CSV output.

## Summary
Route unknown regions through the global endpoint.
## Changes
- Resolve configured regional endpoints from ENDPOINTS.
- Fall back to ENDPOINTS.global when the region is unknown.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Low — unconfigured regions now use shared global infrastructure.

--- a/cli/routes.py
+++ b/cli/routes.py

diff --git a/timezone/resolve.rb b/timezone/resolve.rb
--- a/timezone/resolve.rb
+++ b/timezone/resolve.rb
@@ -3,2 +3,3 @@ def resolve(zone)
+  SUPPORTED.include?(zone) ? zone : 'UTC'
 end

## Summary
Use UTC for unsupported timezone identifiers.
## Changes
- Preserve timezone values listed in SUPPORTED.
- Fall back to UTC for unknown values.
## Testing
- Not run (not shown in diff).
## Risk
Low — invalid timezone settings now resolve consistently.
